about: ROSE <>< creates and archives all FISH <>< COMMUNITY content and promotes the work of rose fish members, who get access to exclusive things like SECRET COOL PLACES IN WORLDS.
Contributions from ROSE FISH members are showcased in a publicly accessible database ensuring visibility within the entire FISH <>< COMMUNITY.
joinIntro: Make a contribution that requires human effort to create and could be easily used by the fish community members.
voteText: After submitting a contribution it will be reviewed by theziver and decided if a vote is necessary, if so all the rose fish members will participate in a 2-day long voting process. To receive a rose fish invitation, the contribution must receive a YES vote from over 60% of the voting rose fish members.
voteCriteriaHeader: Deciding if a vote is necessary @THEZIVER will consider these things:

voteCriteria.title: Presentability
voteCriteria.text: Is the contribution well presented and easy to understand?

voteCriteria.title: Effort
voteCriteria.text: How much human effort was needed to make this? How much did AI help?

voteCriteria.title: Usability
voteCriteria.text: Can it be used for something?

voteCriteria.title: Originality
voteCriteria.text: How different is the contribution from previous contributions?

voteCriteria.title: Collaboration
voteCriteria.text: How many people were involved in creating the contribution?

guidelines.title: AVATAR CONTEXT
guidelines.text: Avatar context matters, avatars designed with the intention of being sexual, offensive, or malicious are not allowed.

guidelines.title: CLOTHING
guidelines.text: Avatars can wear skimpy clothing, but it must be used in a non-sexual manner.

guidelines.title: GORE
guidelines.text: Avatars that show realistic violence or gore are not allowed.

guidelines.title: PARODY COMEDY
guidelines.text: Avatars that are loud, disruptive, or malicious are allowed if they're created for comedic purposes. This includes avatars with bright colors, flashing images, and performance-heavy shaders.

guidelines.title: COPYRIGHT RESPONSIBILITY
guidelines.text: By submitting an avatar, users accept the risk of a DMCA strike if they violate intellectual property rights.
